author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam puts together a charming Totoro craft kit designed and made by our friend Beverly Downen of Downen Creative Studios! Made of laser-cut EVA foam, this adorable figure is easy to assemble--no cutting or painting required--and makes for a great weekend project for kids. Thanks to Beverly for sending us a kit!
